about: Tools with a page but no manifest in kit/data/registry/, each with the reason (kit/toolreg.py check). An entry leaves when its manifest arrives; python -m kit tools check fails on a runnable tool that has neither.

tools.batch: plans and prices AutoPipeline over every bucket scan and launches nothing; launches go through its own approval digest, so there is no run to start from here
tools.cli: the kit command line itself, not a tool with inputs and outputs
tools.cloudcost: prices compute from numbers; no file goes in or comes out for VC3D
tools.compute: sums machine time from provenance records; a ledger report with no scan input
tools.cropscan: a library without a command line yet; a manifest needs a command
tools.ensemble: its control needs the same average over the reverse maps; until one run makes both, the registry would refuse a model-output map without a control
tools.false404-relay: a local relay service for fault tests, not a run with inputs and outputs
tools.fetch: mirrors bucket data into a folder (a download service); next, as a manifest that needs --yes-download
tools.gate: ranks readers from committed scores in docs/; a repository report
tools.greeklm: a letter language model for transcribed Greek text; no scan input
tools.harness2: compares agent provenance workflows on generated files; it takes no selection and makes nothing VC3D or AutoPipeline opens
tools.heldout: applies a published trainer's split rule to label masks; a records check with no VC3D output
tools.layers: a format step (surface-volume zarr to layer TIFFs) that other tools call; next, as a converter
tools.leaderboard: writes docs/leaderboard.md from docs/results.json; a repository tool
tools.letterdemo: a guided demo of the letter reader on bundled public data; no selection to bind
tools.letterlines: builds training lines from transcribed lines; a training-data tool
tools.letterread: next: its weights download needs consent first and its letter height needs binding from the voxel size
tools.letters-training: training scripts: training tools get no runnable manifest (no paid compute from any door)
tools.mac-phase0: a Mac setup script that downloads data and builds tools; never started from a menu
tools.mac-verify: a Mac device-agreement benchmark that downloads data; never started from a menu
tools.mac-w045: the Mac benchmark (a 6 GB download and a build); never started from a menu
tools.media: makes the repository's pictures and clips; not a scan tool
tools.meshaudit: audits the public catalog over the network; next, as a report-only manifest
tools.modal-row: appends one row to a Modal ledger; a records tool
tools.phantom: makes synthetic phantoms and stress tests with no selection to bind; next, as a command-line manifest
tools.plan: prints a First Letters plan for a scroll name; planning text, not a run
tools.prizes: the dated prize snapshot; planning records
tools.prizewatch: watches the prize page; planning records
tools.provenance: records and checks provenance; every registry run already writes provenance.json
tools.reader-backends: the letter reader's recognizer choice, a library the reader loads, not run on its own
tools.releases: the repository's release list and README section
tools.run-ledger: the experiment ledger the registry itself writes cost entries to
tools.run-local: the local cost wrapper the registry runs every command through
tools.scroll-lens: a Hugging Face Space: its live search spends quota and needs a yes; free gallery cubes come next
tools.segzoo: a catalog of segmentation model families and a datalist writer; no scan run
tools.soup: averages checkpoint weights; a training tool, so no runnable manifest
tools.starter: the guided starter app for newcomers
tools.strokenet: its first use downloads weights into a cache outside the run folder; a weights input comes next
tools.surfacefix: an experimental multi-step job that needs renders and GPU ink outside itself
tools.toolreg: the registry itself: it runs the other manifests
tools.umbilicus: needs torch and 0.25 to 0.65 GB of slice reads; next, with download consent
tools.v8in-run: GPU inference, planned only; a plan-only manifest comes next
tools.volumeview: builds a viewer link from a hand-written metadata file; next, with the open volume bound
